metadata.title: Kanha National Park: The Baiga Struggle for Survival | बैगा-बाघ भाई-भाई, एक की मौज दूसरे की तबाही
metadata.description:
Join us on a thought-provoking ground report as we shed light on the heartbreaking story of the Baiga tribe in Kanha National Park, Madhya Pradesh. Once the rightful inhabitants of this land, the Baiga tribe, known as a primitive tribe, now face displacement and discrimination as the park prioritizes the conservation of tigers and other wild animals.

In this compelling video, we bring firsthand accounts from the Baiga people. Hear their stories of displacement and the challenges they endure as they are denied access to their ancestral forest to collect vital forest produce. With their deep-rooted connection to nature, the Baiga tribe's traditional way of life and sustenance are under threat.

Our team has delved into the heart of Kanha National Park to understand the impact of this displacement on the Baiga tribe's cultural heritage, livelihoods, and overall well-being. Discover the resilience and determination of the Baiga people as they fight for their rights and strive to preserve their rich cultural identity.
